proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4770 cāla thatch explicitly gives Assamese sāl roof, Bengali cāl thatch and Oriya cāḷa/cāḷā sloping thatch. Hajong tśal and Bhatri cala/cal roof fit this family with source affricate and lateral notation retained. The elicited roof sense is broader than thatch, and local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. This does not equate separate chad roof or cauni thatching forms with cāla. Exact response: cala.

Adivasi Oriya/Bhatri celi and Adivasi Oriya seli fit this regional feminine goat family with source initial aspiration/sibilant and lateral notation retained. The elided-g cheli comparison supports this branch; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: celi.

Exact response: pila.
